Student Feedback & Teaching Administration — Bingkun Qi

A shared starting point for teachers and students, exploring how software can support feedback and everyday teaching administration.

About this project

Questions from a lesson need a clear place to be expressed. This project separates teacher and student sign-in and provides Chinese and English interfaces for everyday teaching feedback.

A fictional lesson on waves illustrates the communication problem: how a student can express a precise difficulty, and how a teacher might turn it into the next explanation. The illustrative workflow runs independently of the live system.

Features and use cases

  • Separate teacher and student sign-in flows
  • Chinese and English interfaces
  • Designed around student feedback and teaching administration
